cdbg.description: Provides annual grants to develop viable urban communities by providing decent housing and suitable living environment, principally for low- and moderate-income persons.
cdbg.allocation_note: San Rafael participates in Marin County's Urban County CDBG program. Funds flow through County of Marin Community Development Agency.

fy2026_status.note: FY2026 appropriations not finalized. President's budget proposed eliminating CDBG. House proposed level funding ($3.3B). Senate proposed $3.1B (6% cut). CR extends FY2025 levels through Jan 30, 2026.

application_process.allocation_process: 40% countywide housing, 60% to three local planning areas
application_process.requirements: Follow HUD and Marin County guidelines

compliance_requirements: Funds must principally benefit low- and moderate-income persons
citizen_participation: Annual Action Plan public comment periods
Marin County Board of Supervisors meetings

key_contacts.address: 3501 Civic Center Drive, Suite 308, San Rafael, CA 94903

home.description: Provides formula grants to state and local governments to create affordable housing for low-income households through homebuyer assistance, rental housing development, and rehabilitation programs.
home.allocation_note: San Rafael participates in Marin County's HOME Consortium. Funds administered by County of Marin Community Development Agency.

fy2026_status.note: FY2026 appropriations not finalized. President's budget proposed eliminating HOME. House proposed eliminating HOME. Senate proposed $1.25B (level funding). CR extends FY2025 levels through Jan 30, 2026.

citizen_participation: Annual Action Plan public comment periods

key_contacts.address: 3501 Civic Center Drive, Suite 308, San Rafael, CA 94903

section_8_hcv.description: Provides rental assistance vouchers to help low-income families, the elderly, and disabled afford decent, safe housing in the private market.
section_8_hcv.allocation_note: Administered by Marin Housing Authority (separate from Marin County government). Waitlist-based program.

fy2025_income_limits.source: HUD FY2025 Income Limits for San Francisco HMFA

eligibility.income_requirement: Generally under 50% of area median income
eligibility.preference_requirement: 75% of vouchers to applicants under 30% AMI
eligibility.citizenship_requirement: US citizens or eligible immigration status

key_contacts.address: 4020 Civic Center Drive, San Rafael, CA 94903

ahtf.program_name: San Rafael Affordable Housing Trust Fund
ahtf.description: Local funds contributed to Marin County's joint affordable housing funding pool.

data_quality.notes: FY2026 federal funding uncertain due to ongoing appropriations process. Marin County allocations based on 2025-26 NOFA. Federal funding levels subject to change when final FY2026 appropriations enacted.
